name: policy-engine-mcp
description: MCP server for multi-language policy evaluation: Cedar (in-process via cedarpy) and Rego (subprocess to opa binary). Includes policy validation and line-based diff with effect classification.

tools.name: evaluate_cedar
tools.description: Evaluate a Cedar policy for a (principal, action, resource, context) tuple

tools.name: evaluate_rego
tools.description: Evaluate a Rego policy by shelling out to the opa binary (graceful fallback when absent)

tools.name: validate_cedar
tools.description: Validate a Cedar policy's syntax (and optional schema)

tools.name: policy_diff
tools.description: Diff two policies; classify added/removed permit/forbid rules
